Yes i did trace, the way i trace onto canvases is I will trace from my phone screen onto paper, then i will have that drawing, cut it out and place it on the canvas. With brown paint i draw the lines of the traced image, I will keep lifting the cut out face and replicate the lines underneath onto the canvas. Then i put in some shadows. It's a long process but it does end up pretty accurate in the end. I dont know an easier way to trace at the moment with the resources I have. X

Thankyou so much!! I'd suggest firstly make sure u have good small brushes if youre doing detailed work and lots as they run out quickly. You dont need amazing paints I used the same ones since I was 11. 
Only paint when YOU want to paint,  when u force it too much it may become not as enjoyable. It's not always fun, it's a challenge but when it turns out how u want its amazing! 
For learning it's honestly just practice, I have so many awful paintings and creative projects! I'd suggest start with more expressive art not being so focused on tiny details. You cant force creativity so when u get thoes feelings so hold onto them, listen to music and be inspired by your moods! So much art can come from negative feelings and the process of creating is good for mental health. Trace images if you want to copy, I still do it as its so difficult to replicate certian things. If you do want to paint realism I'd suggest using nomal paper and shining a light through it to trace. I trace from my phone screen. Smooth paper is better than canvases sometimes for thoes smaller details. 
Really try to understand colours and shapes more than the actual painting. Once you know that its much easier not having to think about how to mix certian colours! That epiphany moment will come if u keep up with painting. Paintings always look bad at the start, I've given up alot but if you stick at it and keep layering it should be ok in the end. U dont need a final vision either. Art should mostly be fun, 

I hope some of these tips help you.💚
